The solubility range of the /p98(bcc.) solid-solution phase in the Nb–Ti–Al system has recently been ob- served to extend further into the ternary diagram than predicted earlier [2].
The /p98 phase in these alloys exhibited B2 (/p98 o) ordering, in which the ordered bcc crystal structure can be represented as two sublattices by the occupation of atoms on alternating {200} planes.

mechanisms.name: Ti substitution for Nb on Nb sublattice sites

evidence.quote: Ti substitution for Nb on Nb sublattice sites was observed in all of the alloys, with the strength of partitioning between Ti and Al atoms being dependent on alloy composition.

mechanisms.name: increase in Ti substitution of Nb on Nb sites raising ordering temperature

evidence.quote: The increase in ordering temperatures with Ti concentration appeared to be associated with the increase in Ti substitution of Nb on Nb sites in the B2 structure.
